english.title: Drugs - travel restriction - fail to surrender passport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to comply with

(A)_[a direction contained in a travel restriction order to deliver up your passport or to cause your passport to be delivered up to a court]_
(B)_[the duty imposed on you by section 35(5)(b) of the Criminal Justice and Police Act 2001 to surrender your passport to the Secretary of State]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 36(3) of the Criminal Justice and Police Act 2001.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
were not in the United Kingdom
at the end of a period of time
during which a prohibition imposed on you
by a travel restriction order
had been suspended
in accordance with section 35(5) of the Criminal Justice and Police Act 2001

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: A travel restriction order may be imposed on an offender convicted of a drug trafficking offence committed after 31st March 2002 for which a sentence of four years or more imprisonment was imposed (section 33 of the Criminal Justice and Police Act 2001).
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant failed to comply with

(A)_[a direction contained in a travel restriction order to deliver up his passport or to cause your passport to be delivered up to a court.]_
(B)_[a direction contained in a travel restriction order to deliver up her passport or to cause your passport to be delivered up to a court.]_
(C)_[the duty imposed on him by section 35(5)(b) of the Criminal Justice and Police Act 2001 to surrender your passport to the Secretary of State.]_
(D)_[the duty imposed on her by section 35(5)(b) of the Criminal Justice and Police Act 2001 to surrender your passport to the Secretary of State.]_

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
